rationale: Test-only fixes for four canary-lane reds: a watch-loop lease test now clears the lane's PULP_BUILD_CLASS, the mac live-resize harness polls for the cover release (bounded, at least 64 ms) instead of a fixed 100 ms wait, and duplicate Catch2 case names in the web-demo and design-panel example tests are renamed. The only non-test edit lowers codesign verbosity in the clean-agent trust check, which reads the same identity fields. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
